description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of various methods evaluated on two datasets, PHEME and PolitiFact. The horizontal axis displays the categories, divided into two main panels for "PHEME" and "PolitiFact," which are separated by a vertical dashed line. Within each panel, six methods are listed in a consistent, unsorted order with slightly rotated labels: "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition." The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy (%)," using a linear scale that ranges from 75.0 to 95.0 with tick mark intervals of 2.5. The chart features grouped bars, where each dataset panel contains a cluster of six adjacent bars corresponding to the methods. The bars are color-coded by category: "Ours" is dark red, "w/o comments" is orange, "w/o text" is light yellow, "w/o select" is light blue, "w/o emotion" is medium blue, and "w/o cognition" is dark blue. Visual emphasis is provided by bold numerical annotations displaying the exact value above each bar, thin black outlines around the bars, and light dashed horizontal grid lines in the background. In the PHEME section, the "Ours" method represents the tallest bar with a value of 89.84, while the "w/o text" method is the shortest at 80.10; the remaining bars for this dataset range between 86.82 and 88.80. Similarly, in the PolitiFact section, the "Ours" method is the tallest at 90.57, and the "w/o text" method is the shortest at 83.02, with the other methods recording values from 84.91 to 89.62.
caption_used: The bar charts illustrate the accuracy percentages for different methods on the PHEME and PolitiFact datasets. Each chart contains six bars representing the categories: 'Ours,' 'w/o comments,' 'w/o text,' 'w/o select,' 'w/o emotion,' and 'w/o cognition,' placed along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled 'Accuracy (%),' uses a linear scale ranging from 75% to 95% with tick intervals of 2.5%. In the PHEME chart, the 'Ours' method achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 89.84%, followed closely by 'w/o select' at 89.80%. The 'w/o text' method shows a significant decline, reaching only 75.10%, the lowest value in the dataset. In the PolitiFact chart, the 'Ours' method again demonstrates the highest accuracy at 90.57%, while 'w/o comments' and 'w/o cognition' exhibit similar performance at 85.85% and 85.74%, respectively. The results suggest that removing text features has the most detrimental impact on accuracy, while the exclusion of comments and cognition leads to comparable performance levels across both datasets.
